tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bsam gling smon bde ba'i 'phel chen gyi ched du gnang ba'i 'dod gsol bka' rtsom bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs phyogs dus 'gro ba yongs dang / khyad par gangs can 'gro ba'i dpal mgon dam pa ma hā gu ru padma 'byung gnas skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi zhabs la tshe 'das sogs gang 'dod bsgyur thogs drangs mar gyur 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad byang zhing dag nas/ mngon mtho dang nges legs myur du thob pa dang / bdag sogs gang 'dod bsgyur/ ltos bcas kyi gtsor byas skye dgu thams cad tshe ring nad med bsam don kun 'grub 'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs thams cad du thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /sarba maṅga lam// ༈ /sangs rgyas bzang po'i rjes sgrub dge ba'i rdo rje sems dpa'i sku'i 'dod srol yi ge brgya pa'i rjes su/ 'gro ba kun gyi mi shes gcod pa can/ /dag pa kun gyi de nyid ston par mdzad/ /bdag med kun gyi chos las 'byung ba yi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma nas sogs/ bar/ sangs rgyas bzang po 'brel par bcas la dgongs/ /sangs rgyas bzang po 'brel par bcas pa yis/ /tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /da lta'i nas/ shog bar/ sangs rgyas bzang po 'brel bcas thams cad la/ las dang nas/ sogs pa bar/ skye zhing skye bar 'byung bar ma gyur cig /gang du skyes kyang bde zhing skyid par shog /dam chos nas/ kyi bar/ sangs rgyas bzang po 'brel bcas thams cad kyang / /ngan song gsum dang sdig pa'i las spyod pa'i/ /rgyal po nas gyur cig bar/ sangs rgyas bzang po 'brel bcas thams cad kyang / /tshe ring nas/ gyur cig bar/ srid rnying dge sgrub mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs kyi rjes su/ chos dbyings mnyam nyid rang bzhin las/

/thugs rjes rtag tu bzhugs pa yis/ /mtha' yas 'gro don lhur mdzad pa'i/ /mi 'khrugs rgyal por phyag 'tshal lo/ /'brug pa bsod nams lhun 'grub sogs/ /bdag la 'brel thogs sdig can gyi/ /sems can ji snyed thams cad kyis/ /sdig ltung nyes kun sbyang du gsol/ /de dag 'chi 'pho'i sems can rnams/ /mnar gcod sdug bsngal med par shog /srid pa bar do'i sems can rnams/ /'jigs med rang dbang thob par shog /'jig rten nas/ bsil bar shog bar/ dud 'gro nas/ bsil bar shog bar/ lha dang lha min mi yul gyi/ /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /rtag tu dal 'byor lus thob nas/ /dge ba'i bshes dang mjal bar shog /byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing / /thos bsam sgom la brtson par shog /tshe ring nad med 'byor ldan zhing / /bstan 'gror phan bde'i byed por shog /lung rtogs yon tan mthar phyin pa'i/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su kun gyur cig/ //shing lug zla ba bcu pa'i tshes 10la// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ bsam gling smon bde ba'i 'phel chen gyi ched du gnang ba'i 'dod gsol/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
